mise.description: The build and job images keep their own mise configurations, and their file names do not match the native manager's defaults, so without this override the entire container toolchain is unmanaged. The default patterns are repeated here because an override replaces them rather than adding to them. Renovate derives a lock file name of `mise.lock` for these non-standard basenames and therefore leaves docker/*-mise.lock alone; scripts/pin_integrity.mjs fails the build when a declaration and its lock disagree, so a stale lock cannot pass silently.

packageRules.description: Rust toolchain patch releases are frequently compiler-correctness backports (1.97.1, 1.98.1). Keep every pin site in one PR and never delay it.

customManagers.description: mise installer pin in both image Dockerfiles. The mise binary is curl-bootstrapped before any lockfile exists, so it is the one tool the mise manager cannot see.

Rust stable toolchain channel: rust-toolchain.toml is the single source of truth, and every mise lockfile mirrors the resolved version. All four sites must move together or the built artifact diverges from the declared toolchain.
The job image asserts the installed sccache version during the build. The assertion repeats the docker/job-mise.toml pin and must be bumped in the same pull request or the image build breaks.
Same shape as the sccache assertion: the job image greps mbx --version for a literal that repeats the mr-boxington pin in docker/job-mise.toml.
